footer.about: SeniorPadi is free. We list community events for people aged 60 and over in Ibadan.
home.headline: Something to do this week, with people your age, near you in Ibadan.
home.intro: Exercise groups, church programmes, skills classes and more. All free to join.
home.step1: Create an account with your phone number.
home.step2: Pick an event and tap Register.
home.step3: We text you to confirm, and again before the day.

home.volunteer_text: Some events need volunteers. Teach a skill, welcome people at the door, or help set up. Look for the green Volunteer button.
home.family_text: That's fine. Use their phone number so the reminders go to them.

onboarding.title: Welcome to SeniorPadi
onboarding.intro: A short guide to how everything works. You can skip it and come back from Settings any time.
onboarding.video_trouble: Video not playing? Everything it says is written below.
onboarding.default_transcript:
Welcome to SeniorPadi. It's free, and it's for people aged 60 and over in Ibadan.

Finding something to do: tap Events. You'll see what's happening this week, and later. Tap an event to read more.

Joining: tap Register. We'll send you a text to confirm, and another text before the day. On the day, just come. Your name will be on the list.

Can't make it? Go to My places and cancel, so someone else can have your place.

Helping out: some events need volunteers. Look for the green Volunteer button.

Meeting people: in Find Seniors you can chat with other seniors. For everyone's safety, we check an ID first. If anyone makes you uncomfortable, tap Report a problem.

If a family member is helping you, that's fine. Welcome, and enjoy.
